name: Jaffna Hills
description: Thirteen bodies are unearthed in the mist-covered slopes of Jaffna Hills near Dehradun - victims of a killer who has been hunting in silence for seventeen years. As panic grips the city, SP Crime Vijay Kohli leads the investigation, but the case hits dangerously close to home.

videos.overview: Thirteen bodies are found in Dehradun’s Jaffna Hills, and the police try to silence the horror before the city panics.
